data.standardized_narrative: The report provides the balance sheet and technical provisions notes but does not present a clearly extractable GROSS prior-year movement figure in the places scanned. The opening gross claims outstanding (closing 2016 / opening 2017) was identified in the technical provisions note (At 1 January 2017) as approximately GBP 389.1m. A gross prioryear development (release or strengthening) figure for 2017 versus prior years could not be unambiguously located in the gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note or narrative text in the scanned pages, so no quantified prior year movement is reported here.
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction uncertainty: the scanned images are rotated and some tables are partially obscured. I located a likely 'At 1 January 2017' gross claims outstanding value in the Technical Provisions note (page ~23) and used that as opening_reserves_gbp_m (389.1). However I could not find a clear, explicit GROSS prior-year movement (the authoritative source required by the rules). The Profit & Loss Technical Account contains 'Claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' lines, but per the instructions those are P&L claims-incurred lines and must not be used as the prior-year reserve movement; therefore I have not used them. A claims development triangle appears in the notes (page ~24) but the scanned image quality prevented reliable numeric extraction of the triangle cells to compute PYD as a fallback. Gross premium total (462.2) was readable from the Statement of Total Comprehensive Income (page ~1) and is provided with moderate confidence. Where numbers were unclear I left fields null rather than risk incorrect values.
